parsed.rationale: All four members are `type-alias-object` declarations with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural signal is that they share the same shape (a bare type alias with no fields) rather than any meaningful semantic duplication. `LargeNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `SmallNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, `MediumNowPlayingWidgetEntryView`, and `Header` are distinct widget view aliases that correspond to different WidgetKit size classes and a header component — their coincidental structural identity (both have `shared_field_count: 2` and `differing_slots: null`) reflects the fact that type aliases carry no body, not that they encode the same concept. Collapsing them would destroy the intentional size-class differentiation required by the WidgetKit entry-view API. No restraint markers are present, but the domain concepts are unrelated enough that no extraction is warranted.
